title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates wave speed using v = PA / (time wave from A reaches P).

title: Resultant amplitude at P
description: Important: Correctly determines the amplitude at point P by superimposing the two waves, considering path difference and phase.

title: Timeline of P's motion
description: Important: Correctly identifies the times when P starts vibrating and when each wave arrives, establishing the intervals for SHM.

title: Distance in SHM intervals
description: Important: Correctly calculates the distance traveled by P in each time interval based on its amplitude and the number of oscillations/quarter periods.

title: Total distance summation
description: Essential: Correctly sums the distances from all intervals to find the final total distance traveled by P.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (e.g., meters, seconds) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect path difference phase
description: Pitfall: Mistakenly adds amplitudes instead of subtracting them, or incorrectly assumes constructive interference.

title: Misidentifying start time
description: Pitfall: Assumes P starts vibrating at t=0 instead of t=2s, or misinterprets the arrival time of the wave from B.
